title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.3.6
subtitle: Automatic render provenance and a clearer first-run experience.

highlights.title: ThreadMarked Renders
highlights.description: Eligible automatic SDR renders now carry an invisible Cloth NeXt provenance signal.

highlights.title: Welcome and What's New
highlights.description: Compact Companion screens introduce the workflow and each new build without interrupting Blender.

improvements.text: PNG, JPEG, WebP, and TIFF stills and animation frames are processed fail-open after Blender writes them.
Preferences now provide direct access to Welcome, What's New, and the full changelog.

fixes.text: Opening another Blender file no longer leaves stale viewport-shading references behind.
